title: Language Ideologies in a Multilingual Society: An LLM-based Analysis of Luxembourgish News Comments

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM performance on a multi-class sentence annotation task to detect and classify language ideologies (beliefs about language status, vitality, and recognition) in a corpus of Luxembourgish news comments, including testing the effects of cross-lingual transfer.

Assessing the ability of LLMs to identify text containing ideologies related to national identity and social belonging, specifically how user comments distinguish between native Luxembourgers and foreigners or cross-border commuters based on linguistic integration.
